economic_policy.taxation: Lower marginal tax rates across all brackets; reduce corporate tax to attract investment; eliminate estate tax; simplify tax code.
economic_policy.trade: Bilateral trade deals that prioritise national economic interests; enforce fair-trade provisions; protect domestic industries from unfair competition.
economic_policy.regulation: Reduce regulatory burden on businesses; cost-benefit analysis for all new regulations; sunset clauses on major rules.

social_policy.healthcare: Market-based healthcare with expanded health savings accounts; enable cross-state insurance competition; protect employer-sponsored coverage.
social_policy.education: School choice through vouchers and charter schools; local control of curriculum; merit-based teacher pay; vocational training expansion.
social_policy.housing: Reduce government intervention in housing markets; ease construction regulations to increase supply; promote homeownership through tax incentives.
social_policy.civil_rights: Protect religious liberty; uphold constitutional rights as written; oppose government mandates that infringe on conscience protections.
social_policy.immigration: Secure borders with physical and technological barriers; merit-based legal immigration; mandatory E-Verify; oppose amnesty programmes.

governance.decentralization: Return power to state and local governments; block-grant federal programmes; reduce size of federal bureaucracy.
governance.transparency: Audit federal agencies for waste and duplication; publish government spending in real time; term limits for legislators.
governance.electoral_reform: Voter ID requirements; maintain single-member district elections; clean voter rolls; oppose federal election mandates.

environment.climate_action: Technology-driven solutions over regulatory mandates; support carbon capture research; oppose economy-wide carbon taxes.
environment.energy: Energy independence through all-of-the-above strategy including oil, gas, nuclear, and renewables; streamline permitting for energy projects.
environment.conservation: State-led conservation partnerships; responsible resource management; support hunting and fishing heritage; oppose federal land grabs.

security.defense: Peace through strength; maintain military superiority; modernise nuclear deterrent; honour commitments to allies.
security.law_enforcement: Back the badge with funding and legal protections; mandatory minimum sentences for violent crimes; combat drug trafficking.
security.foreign_policy: America-first diplomacy; rebuild alliances on burden-sharing basis; confront adversaries with credible deterrence; cautious about nation-building.
